gate: 15.1 — A2A Capability Fit and Authority Boundary

correction.reason: The historical versioned v0.3.0 documentation page was incorrectly treated as the current latest stable protocol baseline. Current official A2A documentation identifies 1.0.0 as the latest released protocol version.

official_python_sdk_snapshot.gate_15_2_action: inspect exact 1.1.4 dependency and framework surface before any pin

v1_0_material_differences_relevant_to_op: protocol supports multiple standard bindings rather than one implicit JSON-RPC transport
AgentCard uses supportedInterfaces with per-interface protocolBinding, url, and protocolVersion
protocol version is an AgentInterface property rather than a top-level AgentCard property
v1.0 introduces a stable production-ready major-version contract
binding choice must be explicit and must not be confused with business authority

capability_fit.hypothesis: An A2A adapter can carry only an already-admitted specialist-task reference across a bounded peer boundary and re-bind protocol results to existing OpsLens content identities without allowing protocol input, peer metadata, task state, or artifacts to create capability or business authority.

permanent_invariants: A2A AgentCard skill != OpsLens capability authorization
A2A context/task identity != OpsLens source-task identity
MCP is an interoperability boundary, not new business authority
next_gate_requirements: choose JSON-RPC explicitly as the first bounded binding rather than treating it as the only A2A binding
inspect official Python SDK 1.1.4 package and dependency placement before pinning
freeze exact reference-only contract before framework coercion
freeze AgentCard supportedInterfaces projection with protocolVersion 1.0
bind A2A request/message/task/context identities to OpsLens evidence only
reject unknown or tampered references fail closed
explicit_non_claims: A2A is not retained production architecture
no public or deployed A2A runtime exists
production TLS/authentication posture is not proven
exactly-once A2A execution is not proven
A2A does not create capability authorization
A2A artifacts are not automatically admitted business evidence
JSON-RPC is an OpsLens first-experiment binding choice, not the only A2A v1.0 binding
AgentCore is not selected as A2A hosting
MCP is not promoted to public runtime
runtime exposure truth is not created
next_authorized_gate: Gate 15.2 — bounded offline A2A 1.0 reference-only adapter contract
